radar.groups[0..11] (all 12 groups): Agreed. k = 12 was fixed in amendment 7 before clustering, Three crash themes and three price themes overlapped. Amendment 8 merged the groups by a rule fixed in advance (section 1); the original 12 are in Appendix A.
radar.groups[*].years: Partly. Year counts are raw voices with no per-year denominator, so the report draws no trend from them. 2026 is not an error: the harvest ran in November 2026.
radar.by_platform: Agreed. The radar is one customer-voice family (App Store reviews, US/GB/IE). It is not a market-level claim; added to Method and limits.
radar.groups[*].apps: Agreed. Per-app voices are in the Apps column: 'Rising prices and invoice limits' is 108 of 125 Invoice Simple, 'Mobile app is unreliable and limited' is 60 of 97 Harvest. Read single-app themes as app-specific.
simulation.conditions: Agreed. That is why the section is exploratory, sits last and feeds no quantity or node. The intervals are a bootstrap over cells: sampling spread only, not validity.
simulation.conditions[price10 vs price50: Agreed: noise, consistent with price order preserved in only 8 of 27 cases. Shown as a failure signal, not an estimate.
status.gold: Agreed. The report calls these labels model-labelled (Kimi), the GLM figure cross-model agreement, and the human check NOT DONE. 'gold' is only the file name.
t1.trigger / success_criterion / alterna: Agreed. The report shows only counts for these classes, each marked NOT MEASURED (fewer than 20 calls); no precision is claimed.
riskiest[*].priority: Agreed. Priority is the L1 risk ranking of unverified guesses: it orders what to test, not what is true.
alternatives (all): Partly. The map does not use the model's alternative tag (NOT MEASURED); it is name matching by regex. Agreed that it has no quality check: the generic patterns (manually, accountant) also match passing mentions; added to Method and limits.
touch: Agreed. It is a plan, not a result; the report now says not run (B7).
monte_carlo: Agreed. NO GO means do not build yet, because the inputs are missing; it does not mean the market is too small.
